<a id="page-charts"></a>
# Charts and indicators

Progress bars and rings, spinners, badges, gauges, bar, line, donut and plotted charts, and barcodes. Open it when
a UI shows numbers as a picture.

<a id="charts-writing-a-chart"></a>
## Writing a chart

A chart's fields are keys by their own names; its lists (`values`, `labels`, `series`, `data`, `zones`…) are
JSON, or `{expression}` to follow the state. Writers' words, and what they read as:

```notation expands
Column gap=12
  Progress 0.6
  BarChart values=[3,5,4] labels=["Mon","Tue","Wed"] h=160
  LineChart values=[10,12,11,14] h=120
  LineChart labels=["W1","W2","W3"] series=[{"name":"Signups","values":[40,52,48]},{"name":"Churn","values":[8,6,9]}] h=160
  BarChart stacked labels=["Q1","Q2"] series=[{"name":"Direct","values":[30,42]},{"name":"Organic","values":[16,15]}] h=160
  Donut values=[60,25,15] labels=["Rent","Food","Other"]
  Gauge 72 min=0 max=180 limit=100 unit="km/h"
```

It reads as:

```notation
Column gap=12
  Progress value=0.6
  barChart h=160 color=#FF2563EB barRadius=4 maxBarWidth=40 barGap=8 gridColor=#FFE5E7EB baselineColor=#FFE5E7EB gridValues=true gridLabelsLeft=true gridLines=4 gridLabelWidth=44 labelFontSize=11 labelFontFamily="" labelAreaHeight=22 tooltip=true values=[3,5,4] labels=["Mon","Tue","Wed"]
  lineChart h=120 lineColor=#FF2563EB smooth=true scrubEnabled=true cursorLine=true gridValues=true areaTopColor=#00000000 values=[10,12,11,14]
  Chart#lineChart2 h=160 fitMinY=true selectOnHover=true tooltip=true legend=true roundScale=true plotInset=6 axisFontSize=11 dots=12 cursorLine=true chartType=line series=[{"field":"s0","name":"Signups","kind":"line","curved":true},{"field":"s1","name":"Churn","kind":"line","curved":true}] data=[{"label":"W1","s0":40,"s1":8},{"label":"W2","s0":52,"s1":6},{"label":"W3","s0":48,"s1":9}]
  Chart#barChart2 h=160 selectOnHover=true tooltip=true legend=true roundScale=true plotInset=6 axisFontSize=11 barRadius=4 maxBarWidth=40 chartType=bar series=[{"field":"s0","name":"Direct","kind":"bar","stack":"s"},{"field":"s1","name":"Organic","kind":"bar","stack":"s"}] data=[{"label":"Q1","s0":30,"s1":16},{"label":"Q2","s0":42,"s1":15}]
  Chart h=200 chartType=donut legend=true donutThickness=0.22 centerLabel=Total showYAxis=false showXAxis=false gridLines=0 selectOnHover=true tooltip=true axisFontSize=11 series=[{"field":"value","colorField":"color"}] data=[{"label":"Rent","value":60},{"label":"Food","value":25},{"label":"Other","value":15}]
  Stack#radialGauge1 h=164
    RadialGauge#radialGauge1Arc h=fill x=0 y=0 value=72 min=0 max=180 target=100 colorByZone=false segments=0 roundCaps=true thickness=16 majorTicks=0 minorTicks=0 showNeedle=false labels=[]
    Text.heading2#radialGauge1Value "72" size=27 x={"align":0} y={"align":0.05}
    Text.muted#radialGauge1Unit "km/h" x={"align":0} y={"align":0.5}
```

Give a chart a height. The words above write their look on the chart they stand for, as its keys, so a key
written on the line wins (`legend=false`, `selectOnHover=false`, `dots=0`, `barRadius=0`, `roundScale=false`); a
`chart`, `barChart` or `lineChart` written by its type takes none of them and draws as its own defaults say.

- What is under the pointer or a finger is selected and says its value in a tooltip (`selectOnHover`, `tooltip`;
  a line of values: `scrubEnabled`), a line chart with a line up the plot through it (`cursorLine`).
- Round grid lines with their figures, the scale ending on a labeled line (`roundScale`; one series:
  `gridValues`): 2,500 with its separator, 20K for 20000.
- A legend under a chart with two or more named series, and for a `Donut` or a `Pie` its labels with their shares,
  beside the ring where its box has the room, else under it (`legend`).
- A `Donut`'s total in its hole (`total="Visitors"` names it, `total=false` leaves the hole empty; a `Pie` has no
  hole).
- A smooth line with a dot on each of up to 12 points (`dots`), and under an `AreaChart`'s line a fill that fades
  to the foot of the plot.
- Rounded bars no wider than 40 (`barRadius`, `maxBarWidth`); bars of several `series` side by side (`stacked`:
  one on another).

A spinner is `CircularProgressIndicator w=32 h=32` (also `Ring`: an arc going round) or `ActivityIndicator
radius=16` (Cupertino ticks, twice `radius` across). `ProgressRing` and `ProgressIndicator` are not words, and
neither takes `size=`.

```notation
Row gap=12
  CircularProgressIndicator w=32 h=32
  ActivityIndicator radius=16
```

Every chart, however it is written: the labels under the plot never touch (every second, third… from the first is
written, evenly apart, and long ones are first cut to their room with an ellipsis); a series or a slice with no
color takes the theme's next series color (`chart1`, `chart2`… where the theme names them, else its accent and then
colors of other hues as light and as strong as it); a smooth line never rises above or dips below its values.

<a id="charts-a-history-scrub-it-page-it-pan-it"></a>
## A history: scrub it, page it, pan it

A chart over a long history that a finger scrubs and that goes back in time is a [`Graph`](#node-graph): its rows
are the data, its marks what is drawn of them, `selection` what a finger or the pointer picks (its row comes back
on `onChange` as `result.selection`), and the stretch of history shown is either the rows it is given or its
`view`.

Paged: the rows shown are worked out from a page in the state (`slice`), every row across the plot (`fit`), and
buttons move the page. A drag across the plot scrubs: the row under the finger is selected and says its value.

```notation
state page=0
state days=[{"t":"Nov 1","v":3},{"t":"Nov 2","v":5},{"t":"Nov 3","v":2},{"t":"Nov 4","v":6},{"t":"Nov 5","v":4},{"t":"Nov 6","v":7},{"t":"Nov 7","v":5},{"t":"Nov 8","v":8},{"t":"Nov 9","v":6},{"t":"Nov 10","v":9},{"t":"Nov 11","v":4},{"t":"Nov 12","v":7},{"t":"Nov 13","v":10},{"t":"Nov 14","v":8}]
state picked={}
Column gap=8
  Row between
    Button.ghost "Earlier" onTap={page=page + 1}
    Text "{picked.label == null ? 'This week' : picked.label + ': ' + picked.row.v}"
    Button.ghost "Later" onTap={page=max(0, page - 1)}
  Graph h=220 data={slice(days, max(0, length(days) - 7 * (page + 1)), length(days) - 7 * page)} rowKey=t xAxis={"label":"t","format":"","fit":"points","inset":8} marks=[{"type":"line","y":"v","width":2,"dots":3}] selection={"on":"hover","dot":5} interactions={"dragPan":false,"wheelZoom":false,"pinchZoom":false,"axisScale":false,"doubleTapReset":false} onChange={picked=result.selection}
```

Panned: with no `fit` the view is the reader's: a drag pans it back through the rows, `view={{"last":7}}` starts
it on the last seven, a long press (`crosshair.on`) scrubs, and `onScroll` with `result.nearStart` asks for older
rows while `xAxis.moreHistory` says there are some.

```notation
state days=[{"t":"Nov 1","v":3},{"t":"Nov 2","v":5},{"t":"Nov 3","v":2},{"t":"Nov 4","v":6},{"t":"Nov 5","v":4},{"t":"Nov 6","v":7},{"t":"Nov 7","v":5},{"t":"Nov 8","v":8},{"t":"Nov 9","v":6},{"t":"Nov 10","v":9}]
Graph h=220 data={days} view={{"last":7}} rowKey=t xAxis={"label":"t","format":"","moreHistory":false} marks=[{"type":"line","y":"v","width":2}] crosshair={"enabled":true,"on":"longPress","horizontal":false}
```

<a id="node-circularProgressIndicator"></a>
### `CircularProgressIndicator` (`circularProgressIndicator`)

Flutter `CircularProgressIndicator`. With nothing set it is the default (SSUI) spinner: a 2 px arc in the primary color, round-ended, 16 px when it hugs.

- Written `CircularProgressIndicator`; also `Ring`. Level 1 (Widget catalog).
- Takes no quoted string.
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | number |  | 1 | Filled fraction, 0–1; null spins (indeterminate). |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | 1 |  |
| `backgroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | 1 |  |
| `strokeWidth` | number (≥ 0) | `4` | 1 |  |
| `strokeAlign` | number | `0` | 1 | -1 inside the bounds, 0 centered on them, 1 outside. |
| `strokeCap` | `butt` `round` `square` |  | 1 |  |
| `trackGap` | number |  | 1 |  |
| `startAngle` | number | `-90` | 1 | Where the ring starts, in degrees clockwise from 3 o'clock. |
| `sweepAngle` | number | `360` | 1 | How much of the circle the ring spans, in degrees. |

<a id="node-badge"></a>
### `badge` (`badge`)

Flutter `Badge`: over its `child`, a dot or a count at `alignment`. With no child it is the default (SSUI) badge: a tinted label 20 high, as wide as its text, a pill for a `count`.

- Written `badge`. Level 1 (Widget catalog).
- `badge "…"` sets `props.label`; it takes one quoted string (a second is said).
- Its children are slots: `child`.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).
- The fields of its text style ([TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle)) are keys by their own names: `letterSpacing=0.4`, `fontFamily="Inter"`.

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | text |  | 1 | The label; null is a dot (`smallSize`). |
| `count` | whole number |  | 1 | `Badge.count`: shown as `maxCount+` above `maxCount`. |
| `maxCount` | whole number | `999` | 1 |  |
| `isLabelVisible` | `true`/`false` | `true` | 1 |  |
| `backgroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | 1 |  |
| `textColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | 1 |  |
| `textStyle` | [TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle) | `{}` | 1 |  |
| `smallSize` | number (≥ 0) | `6` | 1 |  |
| `largeSize` | number (≥ 0) | `16` | 1 |  |
| `padding` | [EdgeInsets](values.md#type-EdgeInsets) | `[4,0,4,0]` | 1 |  |
| `alignment` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) | `[1,-1]` | 1 |  |
| `offset` | [Offset](values.md#type-Offset) | `[4,-4]` | 1 |  |

<a id="node-graph"></a>
### `Graph` (`graph`)

Graph: rows drawn as marks (bars, lines, areas, candles, slices), with its view, cursor and selection as state. Fires `changed` with `${result.view}`, `${result.cursor}` and `${result.selection}` (`index`, `key`, `label`, `row`, and for one bar or slice `name`, `field`, `value`), and `scroll` with the view when it moves (`${result.nearStart}`: older rows are wanted).

- Written `Graph`. Level 4 (Full vocabulary).
- Takes no quoted string.
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | list of JSON | `[]` | 4 | The rows: one per place on the x scale (a month, a day, a slice). |
| `rowKey` | text | `"t"` | 4 | The row field that names a row across updates (its time, its label): how an update is told from a new row and from older rows put before, and how marks find where they were when they move to new values. |
| `xAxis` | [GraphXAxis](values.md#type-GraphXAxis) | `{}` | 4 | The x scale. |
| `marks` | list of [GraphMark](values.md#type-GraphMark) | `[]` | 4 | The marks of a graph with one pane, drawn in order. |
| `yAxis` | [GraphYAxis](values.md#type-GraphYAxis) | `{}` | 4 | The y scale of a graph with one pane. |
| `coord` | text | `"rect"` | 4 | `rect` (marks over the x scale) or `polar` (the rows round a center: `arc` marks, no axes) for a graph with one pane. |
| `guides` | list of [GraphGuide](values.md#type-GraphGuide) | `[]` | 4 | What is drawn at places of the scales, over the marks of a graph with one pane. |
| `panes` | list of [GraphPane](values.md#type-GraphPane) | `[]` | 4 | Several panes over the one x scale. With panes, `marks`, `yAxis`, `coord` and `guides` are not read. |
| `transforms` | list of [GraphTransform](values.md#type-GraphTransform) | `[]` | 4 | Fields worked out from the rows. |
| `selection` | [GraphSelection](values.md#type-GraphSelection) | `{}` | 4 | The selection (hover, tap); off unless its `on` says. |
| `crosshair` | [GraphCrosshair](values.md#type-GraphCrosshair) | `{}` | 4 | The crosshair; off unless `enabled`. |
| `interactions` | [GraphInteractions](values.md#type-GraphInteractions) | `{}` | 4 | What each gesture does. |
| `style` | [GraphStyle](values.md#type-GraphStyle) | `{}` | 4 | Its colors and text. What it leaves out is the theme's: the grid and the labels in its quiet colors, a tooltip as an inverted surface, the marks in its series colors. |
| `legend` | [GraphLegend](values.md#type-GraphLegend) | `{}` | 4 | The legend; none unless its `show` says. |
| `animationDuration` | whole number (≥ 0) | `300` | 4 | Milliseconds the marks take to move to new values when the rows change in a running app (0: at once). |
| `animateIn` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 4 | The marks grow from zero when the graph first shows. |
| `view` | JSON |  | 4 | The view, set from state: on rows `{last: n}` (the last n rows across the plot) or `{barSpacing, rightOffset}`; on a linear scale `{from, to}`. Usually bound. |
| `selected` | JSON |  | 4 | The pinned selection, set from state: `{index}` or `{index, mark}`; null for none. Usually bound. |

<a id="node-barcode"></a>
### `barcode` (`barcode`)

Barcode / QR code.

- Written `barcode`. Level 4 (Full vocabulary).
- `barcode "…"` sets `props.data`; it takes one quoted string (a second is said).
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | text | `""` | 4 |  |
| `symbology` | `qrCode` `pdf417` `code128` `aztec` `dataMatrix` `ean13` | `qrCode` | 4 |  |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | 4 | Null: the theme's onSurface (`ControlTheme`), so it reads in light and dark. |
| `backgroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | 4 |  |
| `errorCorrection` | `low` `medium` `quartile` `high` | `medium` | 4 |  |
| `drawText` | `true`/`false` | `true` | 4 | 1D codes: the text under the bars. |
| `overlap` | number (≥ 0) | `0` | 4 | Pixels each dark bar and module reaches past its right and bottom edge, so neighbors overlap: no hairline seams where anti-aliased edges meet, and a small ink gain (as `canvas.drawRect` codes widen bars to hide seams). 0 draws the exact geometry. |

<a id="charts-records"></a>
## Records

<a id="type-ChartSeries"></a>
### ChartSeries

One series of a chart: the values of `field` in each data row.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `field` | text | `""` |  |
| `name` | text | `""` |  |
| `kind` | `bar` `line` `area` `tick` | `bar` |  |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `#FF2ED17A` |  |
| `colorField` | text |  | A row field holding a per-row color (hex), overriding `color`. |
| `stack` | text |  |  |
| `dashed` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |
| `strokeWidth` | number (≥ 0) | `2` |  |
| `endDot` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |
| `endDotHaloColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  |  |
| `curved` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |
| `fillTo` | text |  | Area series: fill down to this field's line instead of the axis. |
| `fillOpacity` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `0.25` |  |
| `endLabel` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Line and area series: its `name` and last value written at the end of its line, in its color (labels of different series are kept apart). |
| `fade` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |

<a id="type-ChartReferenceLine"></a>
### ChartReferenceLine

A horizontal line across a chart's plot at `value`.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | number | `0` |  |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `#99FFFFFF` |  |
| `dashed` | `true`/`false` | `true` |  |
| `strokeWidth` | number (≥ 0) | `1.5` |  |
| `label` | text | `""` |  |
| `labelColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  |  |
| `labelBelow` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |

<a id="type-GaugeZone"></a>
### GaugeZone

A colored band of a radial gauge, from `from` to `to` in value units.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | number | `0` |  |
| `to` | number | `0` |  |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `#FF000000` |  |

<a id="type-ProgressBand"></a>
### ProgressBand

A colored zone of an arc progress bar, from `start` to `end` as fractions of the max value.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | number | `0` |  |
| `end` | number | `0` |  |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `#FF000000` |  |

<a id="type-PlotChartSeries"></a>
### PlotChartSeries

One more curve on a plot chart, over the chart's x domain: `points` are evenly spaced from xMin to xMax like the chart's own, and a null point is a gap (the line breaks there: an undefined value or an asymptote).

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `points` | list of number | `[]` |  |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `#FF1F6F78` |  |
| `width` | number (≥ 0) | `2` |  |
| `id` | text | `""` |  |

<a id="type-PlotChartLabel"></a>
### PlotChartLabel

A label on a plot chart's x axis, centered on `x`.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | `0` |  |
| `label` | text | `""` |  |

<a id="type-PlotChartMarker"></a>
### PlotChartMarker

A labeled dot on a plot chart (on the curve when `y` is null).

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | `0` |  |
| `y` | number |  |  |
| `label` | text | `""` |  |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `#FF000000` |  |
| `position` | `above` `below` | `above` |  |
| `shape` | `dot` `ring` `square` `diamond` | `dot` | The marker's shape. A ring and a square are outlined in `color` and filled with `fillColor`; a dot is filled with `color`; a diamond is filled with `fillColor` and outlined in `strokeColor`. |
| `radius` | number |  | The size: a dot's or ring's radius, half a square's side, a diamond's half diagonal. Null uses the chart's markerRadius. |
| `fillColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  |  |
| `strokeColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | An outline around a dot or diamond (none by default for a dot; black for a diamond). |
| `strokeWidth` | number |  | The outline width (default 2 for a ring and square, 1.2 for a dot or diamond's `strokeColor`). |

<a id="type-PlotChartRange"></a>
### PlotChartRange

A shaded x range of a plot chart, painted behind the curve.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | number | `0` |  |
| `to` | number | `0` |  |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `#19000000` |  |
| `label` | text | `""` |  |
| `labelColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  |  |

<a id="type-PlotChartYLine"></a>
### PlotChartYLine

A horizontal line across a plot chart at `y`: a grid line, or a reference such as a target (dashed, with an inline `label`). `axisLabel` is written in the chart's y-axis gutter (`PlotChartProps.yAxisWidth`).

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `y` | number | `0` |  |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `#19000000` |  |
| `width` | number (≥ 0) | `1` |  |
| `dashed` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |
| `label` | text | `""` |  |
| `labelBackground` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  |  |
| `axisLabel` | text | `""` |  |

<a id="charts-examples"></a>
## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).

<a id="charts-example-pages-charts-json"></a>
### pages/charts.json

From [`pages/charts.json`](../charts.md).

```notation
state done=4
canvas h=300
Column#col gap=12 pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":300}
  Text#goal "{done} of 7 days" size=15 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":20}
  Progress#bar w={"fill":342} h=10 value={done} max=7 borderRadius=5 color=#FF16A34A
  barChart#week w={"fill":342} h=160 color=#FF16A34A labelFontFamily=Roboto values=[1,1,0,1,1,0,0] labels=["M","T","W","T","F","S","S"]
```
